example_sentences_in_bangla: সুন্দরবনের জঙ্গলে দক্ষিণ রায়ের মতো ভয়ংকর কিছু নেই।
সে দক্ষিণ রায়ের মতো শক্তিশালী এবং ভয়ঙ্কর।
example_sentences_in_english: Nothing in the Sundarbans jungle is as fearsome as Dakshin Ray.
He is as powerful and terrifying as the tiger of the Sundarbans.
history: দক্ষিণ রায় is a folk deity in Sundarbans folklore, worshipped by villagers as the tiger god to seek protection from wild tigers and forest dangers.
note: Refers to the mythical tiger deity in Bengali coastal culture.
